# Lingvo Go

> > Lingvo Go is an AI-powered Hebrew learning platform designed for beginners, offering personalized courses and adaptive exercises to support language acquisition and immigrant integration.

Lingvo Go provides comprehensive Hebrew language education through its flagship Ulpan Alef course, leveraging artificial intelligence to deliver adaptive learning experiences. The platform serves both individual learners and groups with flexible subscription options and free learning resources.

## Key Topics

- Hebrew language learning
- Ulpan Alef course

## Core Learning Platform

- [Lingvo Go Homepage](https://www.lingvogo.com): Main entry point for the free Hebrew course platform with AI-powered personalized learning support
- [Lingvo Go Learning Dashboard](https://go.lingvogo.com): Interactive learning platform dashboard providing access to course catalog and personalized lessons
- [Ulpan Alef Hebrew Course](https://www.lingvogo.com/ulpanalef): Comprehensive beginner Hebrew course with AI-powered adaptive exercises and personalized learning paths
